name: Virginia
gaps: Localities set and bill their own personal property tax on vehicles and, in many places, a local registration fee; DMV does not publish a statewide table, so neither is added.

The highway use fee of fuel-efficient gasoline and hybrid cars (25 mpg or more combined) depends on the car's EPA rating, which the form does not ask; it is shown as a range up to the electric-vehicle amount.
Safety inspection and Northern Virginia emissions test prices are paid to stations and were not read on an official page for this release.
No dealer documentation fee cap was read on an official page for this release.
Whether a dealer processing fee is part of the 'sale price' is not stated in the definition read; the engine leaves it out of the taxable price.

summary.inspectionWhere: Emissions inspection in Arlington, Fairfax, Loudoun, Prince William and Stafford counties and five Northern Virginia cities ($2 yearly emissions fee with registration); statewide safety inspection by stations.

tax.label: Motor vehicle sales and use tax (4.15%, minimum $75)

ranges.label: Highway use fee if the car is rated 25 mpg or more
ranges.note: 85% of the gas tax a 23.7 mpg car pays minus what yours pays, on 11,600 miles; depends on your EPA rating.

ranges.label: Local personal property tax on the vehicle
ranges.note: Set and billed by your county or city each year.

counties.name: Any other Virginia county or city

singular: Virginia taxes a car purchase at 4.15% of the sales price with a minimum of $75, and DMV collects it at titling [fee-chart].
Virginia gives no tax credit for a trade-in: the law defines the sale price without any allowance for trade-ins, but excludes manufacturer rebates [va-code].
Registration is cheap and weight-based: $30.75 a year up to 4,000 lb and $35.75 from 4,001 to 6,500 lb for a passenger car [fee-chart].
The bigger yearly bill is local: counties and cities tax vehicles as personal property and many add a local registration fee [fee-chart].
Electric cars pay a yearly highway use fee of $135.63 in the 2026 fee chart, updated every July 1 [fee-chart].
Gasoline and hybrid cars rated 25 mpg or more also pay a highway use fee, computed as 85% of the gas tax they avoid compared with a 23.7 mpg car over 11,600 miles [huf].
Cars garaged in five Northern Virginia counties and five cities need an emissions inspection and pay a $2 emissions fee with registration [emissions].
A two-year registration costs twice the annual fee, with a small discount for renewing online [registration].

fee-chart.name: Virginia DMV, DMV 201 Fee Chart (08/10/2026)
fee-chart.quote: Passenger - 4,000 lbs or less $30.75 ... Passenger - 4,001 lbs to 6,500 lbs $35.75 ... Electric Vehicle $135.63 ... Original title $15.00 ... Vehicle sales and use tax 4.15% of sales price, minimum charge $75.00.

huf.name: Virginia DMV, Highway Use Fee
huf.quote: HUF= [((11,600 average miles traveled * fuels tax rate ) / 23.7) - ((11,600 average miles traveled * fuels tax rate) / vehicle's MPG rating)] * .85

emissions.name: Virginia DMV, Emissions Inspection
emissions.quote: Counties of Arlington, Fairfax, Loudoun, Prince William or Stafford; Cities of Alexandria, Fairfax, Falls Church, Manassas or Manassas Park

registration.name: Virginia DMV, Register Your Vehicle
registration.quote: Two-year registration costs twice the annual fee

va-code.name: Code of Virginia § 58.1-2401, definitions (sale price)
va-code.quote: "Sale price" means the total price paid for a motor vehicle ... without any allowance or deduction for trade-ins or unpaid liens or encumbrances. However, "sale price" does not include (i) any manufacturer rebate
